description: This script automates the setup of Apple App Store Connect API keys by storing the key in the macOS Keychain, setting environment variables, and optionally updating environment files. It handles command-line arguments for key parameters, validates inputs, and provides usage guidance.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: upsert_env_line
methods.description: Updates or inserts a key-value pair into the specified environment file, replacing existing entries if present.

methods.name: delete_env_line
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the environment file if it exists.
